name: idmji.org
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 20 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: idmji.org scores 62 out of 100 (D). 7 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: 20 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /estudios-biblicos/, /ensenanzas/, /meditaciones/ and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 65 elements on /, /estudios-biblicos/, /ensenanzas/, for example .top-bar-right-button and .mcb-column-inner-g359jxkbj > .align_center.button_align > .button_size_3.button_left.button > .button_label. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 56 elements on /, /estudios-biblicos/, /ensenanzas/, for example .alignnone[aria-label="Image with links"][role="link"] > .image_wrapper > a[target="_blank"][title=""] and .post-134184 > .images_only.post-photo-wrapper.image_frame >…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 18 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (6 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies _ga_FB2RDDC7WQ, _ga, _gcl_au.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
